title: Assertion: Lock Mutual Exclusion
constraints: Rule 1: at most one lock grant at a time. Rule 2: a **new** grant (a rising `lock_gnt[i]`) only goes to a master that is requesting.
Rule 3: a grant is never revoked while its owner keeps requesting: if `lock_gnt[i] && lock_req[i]`, then `lock_gnt[i]` is still high next cycle.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `$onehot0(lock_gnt)` is an invariant. For rule 2 use `$rose(lock_gnt[i]) |-> lock_req[i]`: the grant legitimately stays high for the cycle in which the owner releases.
Writing rule 2 as the invariant `(lock_gnt & ~lock_req) == 0` contradicts rule 3 at release time. Try it on the legal trace.

examples.title: revoked
examples.input: grant drops while owner still requests
